releaseNotes: Console billing: the plan page now says when a plan renews or ends, shows a scheduled cancellation and the past-due grace deadline, and offers Billing Portal deep links for updating the payment method and cancelling, each returning to the console.

Read the paid period's end from the subscription item, where API version 2025-08-27.basil puts it; the mirror had stored NULL for every live subscription. Record a scheduled cancellation whether Stripe reports it as cancel_at_period_end (classic) or cancel_at (flexible billing mode).

Re-read the account's subscriptions from Stripe when a person returns from Checkout or the portal, and once an hour when an account has a Customer but no mirror row, so the console reflects the purchase before the webhook lands and a lost webhook no longer leaves a paid account without access. The read is paged, ranks a live plan above a past-due one, and retires entitlements no subscription bills any more.

Webhook: parse before recording. A payload this Worker cannot represent is recorded as failed and answered 200; a write that throws releases its processed-event row and answers 500, so Stripe's retry is applied instead of swallowed as a duplicate.

The plan in force is the newest entitled subscription (pickCurrentSubscription), not the newest mirror row, so a late deleted event for an old plan cannot hide the live one or misdirect the cancel deep link.

Checkout: a required consent box above the plan buttons (the Terms' consumer-withdrawal clause), recorded on the Checkout Session and the subscription as metadata; Checkout saves name and address to the Customer, collects tax IDs, states the renewal terms under the pay button, and the Customer carries the account id in metadata.
